text: What does an online store in Uzbekistan need to accept card payments?
prefix: What does an online store in Uzbekistan need to accept card payments?

text: By law, only banks and payment organizations licensed by the Central Bank can connect to card processing centers like Uzcard, Humo, Visa and Mastercard, not stores.
prefix: By law, only banks and payment organizations licensed by the Central Bank can connect to card processing centers like Uzcard, Humo, Visa and Mastercard, not stores.

text: So an acquirer has to sit between the store and the processing center.
prefix: So an acquirer has to sit between the store and the processing center.

text: A bank acquirer takes the card on its own secure page, and the store never sees the card number.
prefix: A bank acquirer takes the card on its own secure page, and the store never sees the card number.

text: The store signs one contract and gets paid into its own account at the same bank.
